landing.exTitle: Start with what you need today
landing.exDesc: All 15 exercises, with the same care. Pick one and the app guides you step by step.
landing.heroSub: CTB brings cognitive behavioral therapy to your pocket. Guided exercises, mood tracking, and thought records — designed by therapists, backed by science.
landing.heroProof: Trusted by 50,000+ people on their mental health journey
landing.phoneExerciseDesc: Identify a challenging situation and explore the thoughts and feelings connected to it.
landing.featuresTitle: Tools that meet you where you are
landing.featuresDesc: CBT is most effective when you practice consistently. CTB gives you structured exercises, gentle reminders, and insights that help you build lasting habits.
landing.feat1Desc: Catch, challenge, and reframe unhelpful thoughts with guided CBT worksheets used in clinical practice.
landing.feat2Desc: Log your emotions throughout the day and discover patterns in how you feel — and why.
landing.feat3Desc: Guided box breathing, 4-7-8, and body scan meditations to calm your nervous system in minutes.
landing.feat4Desc: Plan meaningful activities that lift your mood. Small steps, real momentum.
landing.feat5Desc: See your growth over time with mood trends, exercise streaks, and personalized reflections.
landing.feat6Desc: One-tap access to hotlines and emergency support. Because some moments need more than an app.
landing.howTitle: Three steps to a healthier mind
landing.howDesc: CBT works best when it's simple. CTB breaks it down into small, daily actions that add up to real change.
landing.step1Desc: Rate your mood and note what's on your mind. Awareness is the first step.
landing.step2Desc: Work through a thought record, breathing exercise, or behavioral activation task.
landing.step3Desc: Review your patterns over time. Notice what shifts. Celebrate progress, however small.
landing.streakDesc: You've completed a thought record every day this week. Keep it going.
landing.insightDesc: Your mood tends to lift after morning breathing exercises. Consider making it a daily habit.
landing.t1Text: I was skeptical about doing CBT on my phone, but the thought records genuinely helped me untangle my anxiety. It's like having a therapist in my pocket.
landing.t2Text: The mood tracking showed me patterns I never realized. I now know my triggers and have tools to handle them. It's been life-changing.
landing.t3Text: My therapist recommended CTB to supplement our sessions. The exercises align perfectly with what we work on. It's bridged the gap between appointments.
landing.ctaDesc: Start your free 14-day trial. No card required. Begin your first CBT exercise today.
landing.ctaNote: Free 14-day trial · Cancel anytime · Your data is private
landing.footerTagline: Making cognitive behavioral therapy accessible to everyone, one exercise at a time.
